   605	def do_plan(flows, caps, warmup, pinned, offers):
   606	    bens = compute_benefits(flows, offers, warmup)
   607	    nodes = sorted(caps)
   608	    nidx = {nd: i for i, nd in enumerate(nodes)}
   609	    nn = len(nodes)
   610	    resid = [caps[nd] for nd in nodes]
   611	    pset = set(pinned)
   612	    for fi in pinned:
   613	        for nd in flows[fi].path:
   614	            j = nidx[nd]
   615	            resid[j] -= 1
   616	            if resid[j] < 0:
   617	                return {'infeasible': True}
   618	    knodes = [tuple(nidx[nd] for nd in flows[fi].path) for fi in range(len(flows))]
   619	    cand = []
   620	    for fi in range(len(flows)):
   621	        if fi in pset or bens[fi] <= 0:
   622	            continue
   623	        ok = True
   624	        for j in knodes[fi]:
   625	            if resid[j] <= 0:
   626	                ok = False
   627	                break
   628	        if ok:
   629	            cand.append(fi)
   630	    # node -> bitmask of candidates
   631	    cmask = [0] * nn
   632	    ccount = [0] * nn
   633	    for t, fi in enumerate(cand):
   634	        for j in knodes[fi]:
   635	            cmask[j] |= (1 << t)
   636	            ccount[j] += 1
   637	    bind = [j for j in range(nn) if resid[j] < ccount[j]]
   638	    # drop constraints implied by stronger ones
   639	    bset = set(bind)
   640	    for v in bind:
   641	        if v not in bset:
   642	            continue
   643	        mv = cmask[v]
   644	        rv = resid[v]
   645	        for w in bind:
   646	            if w == v or w not in bset:
   647	                continue
   648	            if (mv & cmask[w]) == mv and rv >= resid[w]:
   649	                bset.discard(v)
   650	                break
   651	    bl = sorted(bset)
   652	    bidx = {j: k for k, j in enumerate(bl)}
   653	    forced = []
   654	    dfs = []
   655	    for fi in cand:
   656	        used = tuple(bidx[j] for j in knodes[fi] if j in bidx)
   657	        if used:
   658	            dfs.append((fi, used))
   659	        else:
   660	            forced.append(fi)
   661	    saved = 0
   662	    for fi in pinned:
   663	        saved += bens[fi]
   664	    for fi in forced:
   665	        saved += bens[fi]
   666	    selected = [flows[fi].id for fi in pinned]
   667	    selected.extend(flows[fi].id for fi in forced)
   668	    n = len(dfs)
   669	    if n:
   670	        dfs.sort(key=lambda t: -bens[t[0]])
   671	        order = [t[0] for t in dfs]
   672	        usage = [t[1] for t in dfs]
   673	        K = len(bl)
   674	        mult = n + 1
   675	        bb = [bens[fi] * mult - 1 for fi in order]
   676	        r0 = []
   677	        for k in range(K):
   678	            c = 0
   679	            for u in usage:
   680	                if k in u:
   681	                    c += 1
   682	            rv = resid[bl[k]]
   683	            r0.append(rv if rv < c else c)
   684	        val, sel = _plan_search(bb, usage, K, n, tuple(r0))
   685	        for i in sel:
   686	            fi = order[i]
   687	            saved += bens[fi]
   688	            selected.append(flows[fi].id)
   689	    selected.sort()
   690	    return {'selected': selected, 'saved': saved}

   693	def handle(obj):
   694	    if type(obj) is not dict:
   695	        raise Bad()
   696	    mode = obj.get('mode')
   697	    if mode == 'replay':
   698	        if frozenset(obj) != REPLAY_KEYS:
   699	            raise Bad()
   700	    elif mode == 'plan':
   701	        if frozenset(obj) != PLAN_KEYS:
   702	            raise Bad()
   703	    else:
   704	        raise Bad()
   705	    caps = parse_caps(obj['capacities'])
   706	    flows = parse_flows(obj['flows'], caps, mode == 'replay')
   707	    fmap = {f.id: i for i, f in enumerate(flows)}
   708	    if mode == 'replay':
   709	        evs = parse_events(obj['events'], flows, fmap)
   710	        return do_replay(flows, caps, evs)
   711	    warmup, pinned, offers = parse_plan(obj['warmup'], obj['pinned'], obj['offers'],
   712	                                        flows, fmap)
